flagged.title: Soweto Uprising and youth resistance
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly claims on slide and in voiceover that the Soweto Students' Representative Council (SSRC) was active pre-1976, when in fact it was formed in August 1976 after the uprising began.

mark_affecting.quote: SSRC active pre-1976 / Groups like the Soweto Students' Representative Council had actually been highly active long before June 1976.

flagged.title: Election 1994 and the new South Africa
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly states that a 20 percent vote threshold was required for cabinet representation (which was actually 5 percent, while 20 percent was the threshold for an Executive Deputy President), directly affecting marks on questions testing the Government of National Unity rules.

mark_affecting.quote: The key rule here was that any party winning over 20 percent of the vote was automatically entitled to representation in the cabinet.
